interfaces.contract: Input-preserving signed integer quotient/remainder products and scalar projections retain the standard parameter/field types and require a defined C domain. Pure quantum arguments and once-only CPU integer inputs are adapted; effectful quantum arguments need sequenced capture. Classical structure results can prepare fresh quantum fields. Unbound templates have structural validation only; numerical synthesis requires values. Constant power-of-two lowering is table-free. Full div_t products can be generated on the declared target; two 64-bit fields plus a live input exceed the current 128-qubit representation. interfaces.name: imaxabs
interfaces.classical: GCC/libc target; not an exhaustive certification
interfaces.contract: Input-preserving signed integer absolute value; representable result required. Builtins and external system declarations are adapted. Width, gate and simulator budgets apply; current tests cover narrow promoted sources and a complete small signed state domain, not every 64-bit input.

interfaces.name: imaxdiv
interfaces.classical: GCC/libc target; not an exhaustive certification
interfaces.contract: Input-preserving signed integer quotient/remainder products and scalar projections retain the standard parameter/field types and require a defined C domain. Pure quantum arguments and once-only CPU integer inputs are adapted; effectful quantum arguments need sequenced capture. Classical structure results can prepare fresh quantum fields. Unbound templates have structural validation only; numerical synthesis requires values. Constant power-of-two lowering is table-free. Full div_t products can be generated on the declared target; two 64-bit fields plus a live input exceed the current 128-qubit representation. Small complete phased states and inverse are validated separately from wide circuit generation. General product ABI, library composition and wider resource budgets remain open.
